data.body: Independently re-verified from all four traces: max_consecutive_repeat is inverted as described (bf31 4-signature cycle, 31-37 repeats per signature, scores 1; the healthy c827 full run scores 5). Windowed distinct-ratio (window 24, trip <=0.50, order-insensitive) confirmed: fires at calls 88/151/196 on the three pathological runs; never on the clean run, whose minimum w24 ratio is 0.833 — wide margin. Note the false-positive bound rests on ONE healthy trace; recommend recording the new field for several healthy gate runs before wiring the actuator trip to it, which the default-on usage recording in c827's proposal enables.
